releaseTitle: ECHO v1.0.1 — Performance, Audio Cache & Lock-Screen Polish
releaseNotes:
• Upgraded Media3 audio cache pipeline with 250MB local LRU buffering
• Fluid soundwave progress bar on mini-player and expanded now-playing screen
• Added native 3x1 and 4x2 interactive launcher widgets
• Fixed background playback battery drain on Android 14/15
• Direct in-app update installer via FileProvider
